title: Merging overlapping thermal sensor views for room counting
abstract: Frames from overlapping thermal sensors are merged on a server into one room image before counting.
description: Two or more thermal sensors with overlapping fields of view stream their frames to a building server. The server registers the frames to a common floor grid, merges them into one thermal image of the room, and counts people in the merged image so that a person in the overlap is counted once.

claims.text: A system comprising a plurality of thermal sensors with overlapping fields of view and a server configured to receive frames from each sensor, register the frames to a common grid, merge the registered frames into a single room image, and count persons in the single room image.
